dog.description_text:
Banyan is a 1-year-old tabby with a soft, thoughtful presence and a gentle curiosity about the world around her. She’s a shy, delicate girl who prefers to take things slow—but behind that quiet exterior is a playful spirit just waiting to shine.

When she first arrives, Banyan will likely find a cozy hiding spot and take her time adjusting. She’s not one for big, overwhelming gestures—but offer her a calm environment, a soft voice, and a little patience, and you’ll start to see her blossom.

Her playful side is already there—she loves chasing feather toys and ribbons, and has a particularly strong opinion that red toys are the best toys. She’ll even grab her favorites and run off with them, entertaining herself in the cutest way.

Banyan is also a big fan of treats—Churus, Temptations, and freeze-dried chicken are all fair game and a great way to win her over. While she’s not quite ready for pets just yet, she’s curious and wants to be close, which is a beautiful start.

She shares a special bond with her brother Balsam, and the two of them love to play and keep each other company. Together, they offer built-in comfort, confidence, and companionship—making them an especially wonderful pair for a patient home.

Banyan is litter box trained, good with other cats, and would thrive in a quiet, low-key environment where she can continue to come out of her shell at her own pace.

She’s not the kind of cat who demands attention—but she’s the kind who, given time, becomes something truly special.

If you understand that the best things in life take a little patience, Banyan is ready to find her person (and ideally bring her brother along too)

If you would like to give this wonderful cat a home, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
